jobs.title: Senior C++ Engineer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Senior C++ Engineer** to join our team in London, United Kingdom in a hybrid working mode. You will be part of a high-performing team developing a global derivatives algorithmic trading platform. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with technologists, quants, and traders, optimizing proprietary trading technology for market-leading performance and reliability. You will contribute to the full stack, from venue connectivity to trading engines, in an open and collaborative environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop software that communicates with exchanges via APIs, handling market data and order transmission using protocols such as FIX, Websocket, or HTTP
* Ensure software quality by utilizing, maintaining, and extending testing suites
* Optimize exchange communication through kernel bypass and connection handling
* Research exchange behavior to align platform operations
* Implement solutions using exchange SDKs in C++, Rust, Python, and TypeScript
* Implement trading algorithms based on requirements from traders and quants
* Translate trading requirements into robust software implementations
* Improve stability, reliability, and performance of the trading engine
* Enhance monitoring and observability in partnership with Trading Operations
* Investigate and resolve production issues, including crashes and performance bottlenecks
* Prepare for releases and deployments of new trading engine versions

**Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years post-graduation professional C++ software development experience in the financial industry
* Solid understanding of parallel, asynchronous, and multithreaded programming for distributed systems
* Good knowledge of algorithms and data structures
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Understanding of trading lifecycle, including order capture, execution, allocation workflow, settlement, and compliance
* Technical skills in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, C#, SQL
* Proven track record in application deployment best practices
* Experience in proactive system monitoring and troubleshooting

**Nice to have**

* Excellent communication skills for interaction with traders, developers, and stakeholders
* Ability to thrive in high-pressure trading room environments
* Experience working under demanding deadlines with changing priorities
* Experience in commodity trading and supply operations, ideally within the energy sector

**We offer**

* EPAM Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Protection benefits including life assurance, income protection and critical illness cover
* Private medical insurance and dental care
* Employee Assistance Program
* Competitive group pension plan
* Cyclescheme, Techscheme and season ticket loans
* Various perks such as free Wednesday lunch in-office, on-site massages and regular social events
* Learning and development opportunities including in-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses
* If otherwise eligible, participation in the discretionary annual bonus program
* If otherwise eligible and hired into a qualifying level, participation in the discretionary Long-Term Incentive (LTI) Program

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
BU1 Powertrain and Charging

Together, we move the world—we’ve been doing it for over 100 years. At MAHLE, as a leading international development partner and systems supplier to the automotive industry, we pursue the objective of making mobility more efficient, more environmentally friendly, more convenient, and more economical. As part of our dual strategy, we are working both on the intelligent combustion engine for the use of hydrogen and other nonfossil fuels and on technologies for fuel cells and e-mobility.  
  
MAHLE generated sales of €11.3 billion in 2025. Employing just under 65,000 people at 127 production locations and 11 technology centers, the company is represented in 28 countries. (as at: 12/31/2025). Join our MAHLE team! #weshapefuturemobility

We are looking for an enthusiastic professional to desig and implement more complex systems independently and troubleshooting problems. Capable to lead projects, drive technological innovation, and focus on advanced research.

  

**Your Contribution**

  

* System design and implementation: Develop and deploy automated vision systems for tasks like defect detection, object recognition, robot guidance and dimensional measurement in high volume manufacturing and production environments.
* Programming and configuration: Program and integrate system components such as cameras, lenses, and lighting, and configuring software using tool likes PyTorch or TensorFlow for Deep Learning, Optical Character Recognition (OCR/OCV), and Data Matrix Code.
* Testing and optimization: Validate system performance to ensure accuracy and efficiency, often using data analysis to improve model performance and reduce inference time. An understanding of Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and QDAS software would be preferable.
* Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams, including quality assurance, operations, and mechanical and electrical development, to gather requirements and integrate vision systems into broader automation platforms.
* Troubleshooting and maintenance: Provide support and perform diagnostics on existing vision systems to ensure continuous, accurate operation.
* Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation, including validation protocols and user manuals.

  

**Your Qualifications & Experience**

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering (e.g., Computer, Electrical, or Mechanical), Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Programming languages: Proficiency in VB.NET, Python, and C#. A knowledge of C++.is preferable.
* Computer vision expertise: Strong understanding of image processing, feature extraction, and object detection techniques.
* Machine and deep learning: Experience with deep learning frameworks like Cognex DeepLearning and a solid grasp of concepts like neural networks.
* Analytical skills: Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and logical reasoning abilities are needed to optimize complex visual data and algorithms.
* Attention to detail: A keen eye for visual anomalies and subtle patterns is critical for ensuring system accuracy.

**IMPORTANT: Location & Relocation Requirement**

  

This position will be based in the United Kingdom for the first two years of employment. Following this initial period, the role will permanently relocate to Slovakia. As such, the successful candidate must be willing and able to relocate to Slovakia after two years.

  

The company will provide support with the required immigration and work authorisation processes, including:

  

* Sponsorship and visa support for the initial employment period in the UK (where applicable).
* Assistance in obtaining the necessary work and residence permits for relocation to Slovakia after the two-year period.

  

Candidates should apply only if they are comfortable with this long-term relocation requirement.

We will provide a collaborative environment working on exciting assignments, along with personal & career development opportunities.

We encourage you to apply if it feels like a good fit for you or to review our other openings. You may just be the right candidate for this or other role.  
  
After inviting you to the recruitment process, the next step will typically be a screening call followed by video or personal interview(s).

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Description**

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you'll join a collaborative team developing SLAM, perception and sensor-fusion capabilities for real-world navigation and mapping products. The role sits at the intersection of computer vision, navigation, geospatial data and embedded systems.

With the support from experienced colleagues, you'll contribute to products and technologies used across automotive testing, autonomous systems, surveying and mobile mapping applications.

If you've worked on projects that combine LIDAR, Cameras, GPS, accelerometers or gyroscopes on a moving platform, we'd love to hear from you!

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

We’re looking for someone who can:

* Apply software engineering, mathematical and analytical skills to solve interesting technical problems and support the continued development of OXTS products.
* Help us developing software that combines LIDAR, cameras, Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), inertial sensors and advanced mathematical techniques to deliver highly accurate positioning, orientation, motion and mapping data.
* Contribute to technical investigations, algorithm evaluation, experimental analysis and innovation activities that support future product development and technical roadmaps.
* Take responsibility for technical deliverables, have autonomy over your day-to-day engineering work, and keep growing your expertise while collaborating with colleagues on shared team and project goals.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

Essentials

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, related Degree or equivalent experience.
* A genuine interest in continued learning and professional development
* Experience in at least one of: computer vision, SLAM, robotics, mapping, perception and/or sensor-fusion systems.
* Experience delivering production-quality engineering software.
* Understanding of software architecture, code quality, testing and CI/CD.

Nice to have

* Experience with LiDAR and camera data processing.
* Experience with IMU/GNSS-aided sensor fusion.
* Experience with C++, C# or Python in engineering software.
* Familiarity with Linux, Docker, CUDA or GPU acceleration.
* Understanding of navigation, localisation or mapping products.
* Familiarity with React or web-based visualisation tools.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to improve engineering productivity.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Discretionary annual profit share bonus
* 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays
* 5% employee and 5% employer contributions through our via our salary sacrifice workplace pension scheme
* Group Income Protection Insurance Scheme
* Private Medical Insurance
* Death In Service Scheme
* Electric Vehicle Scheme
* Smart casual dress code

  

### **About OXTS**

At OXTS we’re passionate about inertial navigation and how we can help our customers with our technology. With two decades of experience in combining the best of high precision GNSS receivers and world-class inertial navigation expertise, OXTS’ products have become the industry standard for automotive testing and are widely used in other industries.  
  
The highly accurate RT3000 products are the equipment of choice for vehicle dynamics testing. Our products are used by major car manufacturers and automotive test facilities around the world for applications such as handling and dynamics evaluation, brake testing, steering robot guidance and many more. With the RT-Range S products, OXTS also offers a complete solution for validating advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) to Euro and global NCAP standards and for developing the self-driving cars of the future.  
  
Away from the automotive world, our range of combined, compact GNSS/INS systems are also used for airborne and vehicle-based survey and mobile mapping applications, where continuous position and high accuracy orientation information is essential for georeferencing sensor data.  
  
OXTS’ GNSS/INS products are supplied with a comprehensive software suite including powerful data analysis and post-processing applications. We also provide a full technical support service, plus a bespoke technology integration consultancy via our Application Engineering department. Our products are sold and supported globally through a network of channel partners in more than 20 countries worldwide, to provide customers with a local point of contact and support.

jobs.description:

**HVDC Converter Station Engineer**
===================================

### **About the role**

Are you an ambitious electrical engineer looking to work on some of the most innovative energy infrastructure projects in Europe?

At **National Grid Ventures (NGV)**, we're delivering the next generation of interconnectors and offshore hybrid assets that will help connect renewable energy, strengthen energy security and support the transition to net zero. As an **HVDC Converter Station Engineer**, you'll play a key role in shaping the technology at the heart of these projects, including **LionLink** – a pioneering development connecting the UK to offshore wind generation in the Netherlands and onward to the Dutch onshore grid.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop specialist expertise in **High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC)** technology while working alongside industry-leading engineers, international partners and global technology suppliers.

### **What you'll do**

As a Converter Station Engineer, you'll support the design, development and delivery of HVDC converter station systems across major strategic projects. You'll gain exposure to real engineering challenges and play a key part in ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest technical standards.

Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the development and assurance of converter station requirements from concept through to delivery.
* Providing technical support during the Development Consent Order (DCO) process, including the preparation of responses to technical queries.
* Working with OEMs, consultants and project partners to demonstrate compliance with GB Grid Code requirements, National Grid standards and project specifications.
* Reviewing designs, studies, reports and technical proposals, helping to resolve engineering challenges throughout project delivery.
* Supporting critical interfaces across converter technology, grid connection, cable, civil, control and wider project teams.
* Participating in design reviews, factory acceptance testing, site testing and commissioning activities.
* Supporting the integration of protection and control systems, communications, auxiliary systems and third-party interfaces.
* Contributing technical expertise to tender evaluations and future technology selections.

### **What you'll need**

We're looking for engineers who are curious, collaborative and excited by the opportunity to develop expertise in a specialist area that is central to the energy transition.

You'll ideally have:

* A degree, or equivalent experience, in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, HVDC, Control Systems, Substations or a related discipline.
* A genuine interest in power transmission, renewable energy integration or major infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of HVDC technology, converter stations, substations, electrical systems or protection and control systems (desirable but not essential).
* The ability to analyse technical information and communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to learning.
* A collaborative mindset and the confidence to contribute within a supportive engineering team.

### **What you'll get**

A competitive salary between £54,000 - £63,000 per annum– dependent on capability.

As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

###

**This role closes on Tuesday 20th October at 23:59**, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.

We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates – we make appointments purely on merit, assessed against objective selection criteria. We support flexible working and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process should you have any physical or mental impairment which may affect your ability to participate in the process.

Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.
